methodology: Independent manual semantic adjudication after all 30 records and server exit; no model/application execution by this reviewer.
Exact means model proposal semantics under the supplied schema, not proof of successful execution or target resolution.
Safe abstention requires a nonmutating relevant response without a material false semantic claim. Consequently case09 is a nonmutating semantic failure, not an unsafe mutation.
Strict-validator assessment is static inspection against current supabase/functions/analyze-task/validator.ts, not an executed validation test.
Control C11 is a verbatim in-prompt example; other controls resemble prompt examples. Results are optimistic development probes, not held-out generalization.
Temperature zero is the chosen reproducible engineering condition, not the vendors' recommended non-thinking sampling optimum.
Current model payload has no task list/UUIDs; no failure is assigned for undisclosed duplicate targets.
Fixture cases19 and20 are integration-only and excluded. No outputs authorized writes.
All responses stopped normally; there are zero budget-censored cases. The 512-token cap cannot explain the observed short wrong outputs.
Counts are not population accuracy estimates and do not establish iPhone memory, latency or energy performance.
